package store

// Store holds one opened store.
type Store struct {
	Name string
}

// Open returns a store for one name.
func Open(name string) *Store {
	return &Store{Name: name}
}

// Save records one value.
func (s *Store) Save(v int) error {
	s.Name = "saved"
	return nil
}

// Base carries a method an embed promotes.
type Base struct{}

// Touch bumps the base.
func (b *Base) Touch() error {
	return nil
}
